categories.name: Automotive Locksmith
categories.lead: Car keys, fobs and ignitions handled on the spot. Our van carries key blanks, remotes and programming equipment for most makes on the road in Matthews.
categories.summary: Car Key Replacement, Key Fobs, Push to Start, Transponder Keys, Ignition Repair and more...

categories.name: Commercial Locksmith
categories.lead: Storefronts, offices and warehouses need hardware that works every day. We change and rekey commercial locks, set up master key systems, and install access control and panic bars.
categories.summary: Commercial Lock Change, Master Key Systems, Access Control, Panic Bars, Safes and more...

categories.name: Residential Locksmith
categories.lead: From a quick rekey after a move to new deadbolts and smart locks, we secure houses, condos and apartments across Matthews and nearby towns.
categories.summary: Lock Rekeying, Lock Change, Deadbolts, Smart Locks, High-Security Locks and more...

categories.name: Emergency Locksmith
categories.lead: Locked out of your car, home or business? We answer the phone 24 hours a day, 7 days a week and send a mobile technician to you.
categories.summary: Car Lockouts, House & Business Lockouts, Broken Locks, Lost Car Keys and more...

services.name: Car Lockout Service
services.short: Keys locked in the car or trunk? We open the vehicle without damage and get you back on the road.
services.body: Getting locked out of a car never happens at a good time. Our technician comes to your location in Matthews, confirms the vehicle is yours, and opens the door with tools made for the job, so the paint, weather stripping and lock stay intact.
includes: Door and trunk unlocking for cars, trucks, vans and SUVs
Keys locked inside, or lost while you are out
Help at home, at work or in a parking lot
A new key cut on site if the old one is gone

services.name: House & Business Lockouts
services.short: Locked out of your home, apartment, office or shop? We get the door open and check the lock still works properly.
services.body: A lockout at the front door or the office is stressful, especially late at night. We pick or bypass the lock where possible instead of drilling it, and if the lock has failed we can repair or replace it during the same visit.
includes: Houses, apartments, condos and townhomes
Offices, storefronts and storage rooms
Non-destructive entry whenever the lock allows it
Lock repair or replacement on the spot if needed

services.name: Car Key & Remote Programming
services.short: Keys and remotes programmed to your vehicle on site, so you do not have to tow it to a dealer.
services.body: Modern car keys carry a chip that has to be paired with the vehicle before it will start. We connect our programming equipment to your car and pair new keys and remotes, or re-pair ones that stopped working after a battery change or a module replacement.
includes: Chip keys, remote head keys and flip keys
Remote lock, unlock and trunk functions
Erasing lost keys from the vehicle memory
Service at your home, work or roadside

services.name: Key Fob Replacement
services.short: A lost, cracked or dead key fob replaced and programmed the same day.
services.body: When a fob is lost or its buttons stop responding, you do not need to wait days for a dealer order. We stock fobs for many popular makes, cut the emergency blade and program the remote to the vehicle while you wait.
includes: Replacement fobs for many domestic and import makes
Emergency key blade cut to your lock
Programming of lock, unlock, panic and remote start buttons
Spare fobs made from your working one

services.name: Car Key Copying
services.short: A spare car key cut from your working key, before the only one goes missing.
services.body: Copying a key while you still have one is the least expensive way to avoid a lost-key emergency. We duplicate standard metal keys and cut and clone many chip keys, then test the copy in the door and the ignition.
includes: Standard metal keys for older vehicles
Chip key duplication for many models
Copies tested in the lock before we leave
Extra keys for family members or employees

services.name: Push to Start Keys
services.short: Smart keys for push-button-start vehicles supplied, cut and programmed at your location.
services.body: Push-to-start vehicles use a proximity key that the car has to recognize before the start button works. We supply smart keys for many makes, program them to the car and cut the hidden emergency blade, whether you need a spare or lost every key.
includes: Proximity and smart keys for push-button start
All-keys-lost programming for many models
Emergency insert blade cut to code
Old keys removed from the system on request

services.name: Car Key Replacement
services.short: Lost every key to the car? We make a new one from scratch where the vehicle is parked.
services.body: If the last key is lost, stolen or broken, we can cut a new one to the lock or by code and program it to the vehicle, right in your driveway or the parking lot. There is no tow truck involved.
includes: New keys made when no original is available
Cutting by code or by decoding the lock
Chip programming so the car starts
Broken key removal from doors and ignitions

services.name: Transponder Keys
services.short: Chip keys cut and programmed so the immobilizer lets the engine start.
services.body: A transponder key has a small chip in the head that talks to the immobilizer. A copy without the right chip will turn the lock but will not start the car. We cut the blade and program or clone the chip so the new key works like the original.
includes: Transponder keys for many makes and years
Cloning from an existing key or programming to the car
Remote head and flip key options
Testing in door, trunk and ignition

services.name: Ignition Repair & Replacement
services.short: Key stuck, hard to turn or will not go in? We repair or replace the ignition cylinder.
services.body: Worn wafers and worn keys are the usual reasons a key sticks or stops turning. We remove jammed or broken keys, repair the ignition cylinder when it can be saved, and replace it when it cannot, matching it to your existing key where possible.
includes: Stuck or broken key removal
Ignition cylinder repair and rebuild
Full ignition cylinder replacement
New keys cut to match the repaired ignition

services.name: Lock Rekeying
services.short: New pins inside your existing locks so old keys stop working. Ideal after a move.
services.body: Rekeying changes the pins inside the lock so it works with a new key and the old ones no longer open the door. It costs less than replacing the hardware and is the first thing to do after buying a home, losing a key or changing tenants.
includes: Rekeying of deadbolts, knobs and levers
All doors keyed to one key if you like
New keys cut on the spot
Suitable for homes, rentals and businesses

services.name: Residential Lock Change
services.short: Worn, damaged or outdated house locks replaced with new hardware.
services.body: When a lock is worn out, damaged in a break-in or just not the grade you want on your front door, replacing it is the right move. We bring a selection of knobs, levers and deadbolts, or install hardware you already bought.
includes: Front, back, garage-entry and patio doors
Knobs, levers, deadbolts and handle sets
Installation of customer-supplied hardware
Doors adjusted so the new lock latches smoothly

services.name: Lock & Deadbolt Installation
services.short: New deadbolts and door hardware installed and lined up correctly, including fresh drilling.
services.body: A deadbolt only protects the door if the bolt throws fully into a solid strike. We drill and fit new locks on wood and metal doors, reinforce the strike, and make sure the latch and bolt line up without forcing the door.
includes: Fresh installation on doors with no existing bore
Single and double cylinder deadbolts
Strike plate reinforcement
Keyed-alike sets for the whole house

services.name: Lock & Deadbolt Repair
services.short: Sticking, loose or jammed locks repaired before they fail completely.
services.body: A lock that sticks, spins or needs a jiggle is telling you it is about to fail. Most problems come from a misaligned strike, a loose cylinder or a worn latch, and can be repaired in one visit without buying new hardware.
includes: Keys that stick or will not turn
Latches and bolts that miss the strike
Loose handles, levers and cylinders
Repair after an attempted break-in

services.name: Electronic & Smart Lock Installation
services.short: Keypad and smart locks installed and set up, so you can come and go without a key.
services.body: Keypad and smart locks let you give family, guests or cleaners a code instead of a key. We install the lock, check the door alignment so the motor is not straining, and walk you through codes and settings before we leave.
includes: Keypad deadbolts and lever sets
Smart locks you supply or we provide
Door and strike adjustment for smooth operation
Code setup and a quick how-to

services.name: High-Security Door Locks
services.short: Stronger locks that resist picking, bumping and forced entry.
services.body: Standard hardware-store locks are easy to defeat. High-security locks use hardened parts and restricted keys that cannot be copied at a kiosk. We recommend and install the right grade for your doors, at home or at a business.
includes: Pick- and bump-resistant cylinders
Heavy-duty deadbolts and mortise locks
Restricted keys that are hard to duplicate
Upgrades for exterior and storage doors

services.name: Safe Opening, Installation & Repair
services.short: Locked-out safes opened, safe locks repaired or replaced, and combinations changed.
services.body: A forgotten combination, a dead keypad or a worn dial does not mean the safe is finished. We open home and business safes, replace mechanical and electronic safe locks, and change combinations when staff change.
includes: Opening safes with lost combinations or keys
Dial and electronic keypad lock replacement
Combination changes
Home, office and retail safes

services.name: Commercial Lock Change
services.short: Commercial-grade locks replaced on storefront, office and back doors.
services.body: Business doors take far more use than a house door. We replace worn cylinders, levers and mortise locks with commercial-grade hardware, and can rekey the building at the same time so only current staff have access.
includes: Storefront, aluminum and steel doors
Lever sets, mortise locks and cylinders
Rekeying after staff or tenant changes
Work scheduled around your opening hours

services.name: Commercial Access Control
services.short: Keypads, card readers and electric locks that control who gets in and when.
services.body: Access control replaces keys with codes, cards or fobs you can add and remove at any time. We install keypads, readers, electric strikes and magnetic locks, and set them up for the way your business runs.
includes: Keypad and card or fob entry
Electric strikes and magnetic locks
Single doors or several entrances
Repair of existing access hardware

services.name: Panic Bars & Exit Devices
services.short: Push bars and exit devices installed, repaired and replaced on commercial exit doors.
services.body: Exit doors have to open from the inside with one push. We install new panic bars, repair devices that stick or fail to latch, and add exterior trim or alarms where the door needs them.
includes: New panic bar installation
Repair of sticking or non-latching bars
Replacement of damaged exit devices
Exterior trim, levers and exit alarms

services.name: Master Key Systems
services.short: One key for the manager, separate keys for each door. Master keying planned and installed.
services.body: A master key system lets one key open every door while each employee or tenant key opens only its own. We plan the key levels with you, pin the locks and deliver labeled keys, for offices, shops and rental properties.
includes: Systems for offices, shops and multi-unit buildings
Manager, staff and tenant key levels
Existing locks reused where possible
Extra keys and changes later on

faq.a: Yes. Matthews Locksmith answers calls 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including weekends and holidays.
Yes. We are a mobile locksmith. A technician drives to your home, business or vehicle in Matthews and the surrounding towns with the tools and parts on the van.

faq.q: How much does a locksmith cost?
faq.a: Every service has a starting price, listed on its page, for example car lockouts from $65 and lock rekeying from $29. The final price depends on the lock or vehicle, and we confirm it with you before any work begins.

faq.q: Can you make a car key without the original?
faq.a: In most cases, yes. We can cut a key to the lock or by code and program it to the vehicle on site, including many push-to-start models.

faq.q: Should I rekey or replace my locks?
faq.a: If the locks are in good shape and you only want old keys to stop working, rekeying is the cheaper choice. If the hardware is worn, damaged or low grade, replacing it is better. We can advise when we see the door.
